question: In the year 2022, a kho-kho league was started with the name:
solution:
The correct answer is** __Ultimate Kho-Kho League__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ultimate Kho Kho (UKK) **league was started in 2022**
 
• The **first season of UKK was held from August 14 to September 4, 2022. **
 
• The** matches were held at the Shree Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex in Pune. **
 
• The six teams that participated in the first season were:
 
 
• Chennai Quick Guns 
 
• Gujarat Giants 
 
• Mumbai Khiladis 
 
• Odisha Juggernauts 
 
• Rajasthan Warriors 
 
• Telugu Yoddhas 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Odisha Juggernauts won the first season by beating the Telugu Yoddhas 46-45 in the final. **
 
• The **first season of UKK had 64 million viewers, with 41 million of those viewers from India.**
 
• This made it the third-most viewed non-cricket sports tournament in India. 
 
• The UKK league was created to popularise the traditional Indian sport of kho-kho at the national and international level. T
 
• The **league also aims to professionalise the sport and make it more mainstream. **
